WITH delivered AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(o.order_delivered_customer_date AS DATE) AS delivery_date,
    o.order_estimated_delivery_date,
    CASE WHEN CAST(o.order_delivered_customer_date AS DATE) > o.order_estimated_delivery_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_late
  FROM orders.orders o
  WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
    AND o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL
    AND o.order_estimated_delivery_date IS NOT NULL
),
window_delivered AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM delivered
  WHERE delivery_date >= DATE '2018-05-28' AND delivery_date < DATE '2018-06-04'
),
baseline_delivered AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM delivered
  WHERE delivery_date >= DATE '2018-05-21' AND delivery_date < DATE '2018-05-28'
),
window_stats AS (
  SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS completed,
    SUM(is_late) AS late
  FROM window_delivered
),
baseline_stats AS (
  SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS completed,
    SUM(is_late) AS late
  FROM baseline_delivered
)
SELECT
  ROUND(CAST(w.late AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(w.completed, 0), 4) AS value,
  ROUND(CAST(b.late AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(b.completed, 0), 4) AS baseline,
  w.completed AS window_completed,
  w.late AS window_late,
  b.completed AS baseline_completed,
  b.late AS baseline_late,
  ROUND(CAST(w.late AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(w.completed, 0) - CAST(b.late AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(b.completed, 0), 4) AS diff
FROM window_stats w, baseline_stats b;
